verdict.rationale: The docs show Ghostty running on both macOS and Linux from one configuration system. Config reload is documented for each platform, and platform-specific default keybindings sit on top of a shared set of config options. There is no evidence the Ghostty terminal app runs on Windows; only the embeddable library libghostty-vt is described as Windows-compatible, which is not the same terminal. Missing for 10: a Windows build of the Ghostty app, explicit documentation that one config file is portable across platforms, and independent cross-platform corroboration.
